RAW MEANS: 
AC 2022
```{r}
AC_22 <- read_csv(here::here("data_sheets/compiled_sheets/AC_compiledsheet_full_2022.csv")) 

library(dplyr)

#organize the data
AC_22 <- AC_22 %>%
  mutate(
    sample_ID = str_c(Year, Recipient, Gen, str_pad(Transect, width = 3, pad = "0"), Plant_ID, sep = "-"), #create an id column for each individual
    sample_ID = str_replace(sample_ID, "^([^_]*)_", "\\1-"), #use "_" rather than "-"
    F_plant = ifelse(F_plant == TRUE, 1, 0), #make fitness plant binary (1/0) rather than true/false
    Transect = as.numeric(Transect)) #make sure location is a continuous variable

#clean the data
AC_22 <- AC_22 %>%
  mutate(
    surv_to_flower = ifelse(total_fruits > 0 & surv_to_flower == 0, 1, surv_to_flower), #If a plant produced any fruits, it must have survived to flowering, even if the original surv_to_flower entry was coded as 0, This corrects miscodings where survival to flowering was mistakenly marked as 0 despite having fruit production
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Transect)) # We are removing W1 and W2 from these analyses because they were part of a different experiment involving a watered treatment. 
## In the original dataset, we included some extra fitness plants (see `anyFit_P`) in other transects for comparison with W1 and W2. 
### For the purposes of these analyses, we will exclude them and focus only on the `F_plant` values that are recorded for every segment.

AC_22$F_plant[is.na(AC_22$F_plant)] <- 0 #we need to make F_plant 0 and not NA

#Now we want to make sure every segment is represented by one F_plant (because we will filter by F_plant soon)
AC_22 <- AC_22 %>%
  mutate(sample_prefix = substr(sample_ID, 1, 19)) %>% #create a sample prefix with the first 19 characters of sample ID
  group_by(sample_prefix) %>% #group by the prefix
  mutate(
    all_dead = all(surv_to_flower == 0), #flags groups where no plants survived and where there are currently no fitness plants
##if a group has no fitness plants, it randomly assigns one plant in the group to be the fitness plant
    no_f_plant = sum(F_plant) == 0, 
    F_plant = if_else(
      no_f_plant & row_number() == sample(n(), 1),
      1L,
      F_plant
    ) #this will pick different individuals within the group each time unless you set a seed. For the purposes of this analyses, it will not matter because their values will be zero either way.
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-sample_prefix, -all_dead, -no_f_plant) #ungroup and remove the rows that were created\


#Now we want to determine how many individuals within a segment survived to flower
AC_22 <- AC_22 %>%
  mutate(group = ceiling(row_number() / 8)) %>%  # Create a grouping variable for every 8 rows
  # Calculate the sum of 'surv_to_flower' within each group
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(total_surv_to_flower = sum(surv_to_flower, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% # Ungroup to avoid grouped data frame
  # Remove the temporary 'group' column
  dplyr::select(-group)


#Filter to just fitness plants
AC_22_filtered <- AC_22 %>%
  filter(F_plant == 1)

AC_22 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_est_fecundity = mean(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_est_fecundity  = sd(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(est_fecundity))))

AC_22 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_corolla_diam = mean(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_corolla_diam  = sd(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(corolla_diam_mm_SEG))) )

AC_22 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_SLA = mean(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_SLA  = sd(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(SLA_SEG))) )

AC_22 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_d13C = mean(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_d13C  = sd(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(d13C_SEG)))
  )
```

AC 2023
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load and clean year 2 (2023) AC site data
AC_23 <- read_csv(here::here("data_sheets/compiled_sheets/AC_compiledsheet_full_2023.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    F_plant = ifelse(F_plant == TRUE, 1, 0),
    surv_to_flower = ifelse(total_fruits > 0 & surv_to_flower == 0, 1, surv_to_flower)
  ) %>%
  filter(Donor != "random seeds") %>%
  group_by(sample_ID_SEG) %>%
  arrange(Transect, Recipient, Donor, sample_ID_SEG, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    has_f = any(F_plant == 1),
    m_surv = sum(surv_to_flower == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    F_plant = case_when(
      has_f ~ F_plant,
      !has_f & m_surv == 0 & row_number() == 1L ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ F_plant
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(F_plant == 1)

#Filter to just fitness plants
AC_23_G1 <- AC_23 %>%
  filter(F_plant == 1) %>%
  filter(Gen == "G1")

AC_23_G1 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_est_fecundity = mean(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_est_fecundity  = sd(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(est_fecundity))))

AC_23_G1 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_corolla_diam = mean(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_corolla_diam  = sd(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(corolla_diam_mm_SEG))) )

AC_23_G1 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_SLA = mean(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_SLA  = sd(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(SLA_SEG))) )

AC_23_G1 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_d13C = mean(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_d13C  = sd(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(d13C_SEG)))
  )

#Filter to just fitness plants
AC_23_G2 <- AC_23 %>%
  filter(F_plant == 1) %>%
  filter(Gen == "G2")

AC_23_G2 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_est_fecundity = mean(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_est_fecundity  = sd(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(est_fecundity))))

AC_23_G2 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_corolla_diam = mean(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_corolla_diam  = sd(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(corolla_diam_mm_SEG))) )

AC_23_G2 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_SLA = mean(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_SLA  = sd(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(SLA_SEG))) )

AC_23_G2 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_d13C = mean(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_d13C  = sd(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(d13C_SEG)))
  )
```

BB 2023
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

#load year 2 (2023) life history data for BB site
BB_23 <- read_csv(here::here("data_sheets/compiled_sheets/BB_compiledsheet_full_2023.csv")) 

#organize the data
BB_23 <- BB_23 %>%
  mutate(F_plant = ifelse(F_plant == TRUE, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(surv_to_flower = ifelse(total_fruits > 0 & surv_to_flower == 0, 1, surv_to_flower)) #if a plant made fruits, it must have survived to flowering, so the survival indicator is changed from 0 to 1

BB_23 <- BB_23 %>%
  # Create a grouping variable
  mutate(group = sample_ID_SEG) %>%
  # Calculate the sum of 'surv_to_flower' within each group
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(total_surv_to_flower = sum(surv_to_flower, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% # Ungroup to avoid grouped data frame
  # Remove the temporary 'group' column using dplyr::select
  dplyr::select(-group)

#Ensure at least one F_plant per sample_ID prefix
BB_23 <- BB_23 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_ID_SEG) %>%
  # set a stable order so "first" is deterministic
  dplyr::arrange(Location, Recipient, Donor, sample_ID_SEG, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    has_f = any(F_plant == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    # pick first survivor index (NA if none)
    first_surv_idx = dplyr::if_else(any(surv_to_flower == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                                    which(surv_to_flower == 1)[1],
                                    as.integer(NA)),
    F_plant = dplyr::case_when(
      has_f ~ F_plant,                                            # keep existing 1
      !has_f & !is.na(first_surv_idx) & dplyr::row_number() == first_surv_idx ~ 1L,  # first survivor
      !has_f & is.na(first_surv_idx) & dplyr::row_number() == 1L ~ 1L,               # no survivors: first row
      TRUE ~ F_plant
    )
  ) %>%
  # enforce exactly one 1 per segment (guards against accidental multiples)
  dplyr::mutate(F_plant = as.integer(dplyr::row_number() == which.max(F_plant))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-has_f, -first_surv_idx)


#Filter to just fitness plants
BB_23_G1 <- BB_23 %>%
  filter(F_plant == 1) %>%
  filter(Gen == "G1")

BB_23_G1 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_est_fecundity = mean(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_est_fecundity  = sd(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(est_fecundity))))

BB_23_G1 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_corolla_diam = mean(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_corolla_diam  = sd(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(corolla_diam_mm_SEG))) )

BB_23_G1 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_SLA = mean(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_SLA  = sd(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(SLA_SEG))) )

BB_23_G1 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_d13C = mean(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_d13C  = sd(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(d13C_SEG)))
  )

#Filter to just fitness plants
BB_23_G2 <- BB_23 %>%
  filter(F_plant == 1) %>%
  filter(Gen == "G2")

BB_23_G2 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_est_fecundity = mean(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_est_fecundity  = sd(est_fecundity, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(est_fecundity))))

BB_23_G2 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_corolla_diam = mean(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_corolla_diam  = sd(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(corolla_diam_mm_SEG))) )

BB_23_G2 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_SLA = mean(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_SLA  = sd(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(SLA_SEG))) )

BB_23_G2 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_d13C = mean(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_d13C  = sd(d13C_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(d13C_SEG)))
  )
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

#load year 2 (2023) life history data for BO site
BO_23 <- read_csv(here::here("data_sheets/compiled_sheets/BO_compiledsheet_full_2023.csv")) 

#organize the data
BO_23 <- BO_23 %>%
  mutate(F_plant = ifelse(F_plant == TRUE, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(surv_to_flower = ifelse(total_fruits > 0 & surv_to_flower == 0, 1, surv_to_flower)) %>% #if a plant made fruits, it must have survived to flowering, so the survival indicator is changed from 0 to 1 
  filter(Donor != "random seeds")

BO_23 <- BO_23 %>%
  # Create a grouping variable for every 5 rows
  mutate(group = sample_ID_SEG) %>%
  # Calculate the sum of 'surv_to_flower' within each group
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(total_surv_to_flower = sum(surv_to_flower, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% # Ungroup to avoid grouped data frame
  # Remove the temporary 'group' column using dplyr::select
  dplyr::select(-group)

BO_23 <- BO_23 %>%
  group_by(sample_ID_SEG) %>%
  arrange(Transect, Recipient, Donor, sample_ID_SEG, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    has_f = any(F_plant == 1),
    m_surv = sum(surv_to_flower == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    # if none marked, pick deterministically:
    F_plant = case_when(
      has_f ~ F_plant,# keep existing
      !has_f & m_surv == 0 & row_number() == 1L ~ 1L,    # no survivors: pick first row (placeholder)
      TRUE ~ F_plant
    )
```

```{r}
    se_corolla_diam  = sd(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(corolla_diam_mm_SEG))) )

HR_22 %>%
  summarise(
    avg_SLA = mean(SLA_SEG, na.rm = TRUE),
```

HR 2023
```{r}
#load year 2 (2023) life history data for HR site
HR_23 <- read_csv(here::here("data_sheets/compiled_sheets/HR_compiledsheet_full_2023.csv")) 

#organize the data
HR_23 <- HR_23 %>%
  mutate(F_plant = ifelse(F_plant == TRUE, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(surv_to_flower = ifelse(total_fruits > 0 & surv_to_flower == 0, 1, surv_to_flower)) %>% #if a plant made fruits, it must have survived to flowering, so the survival indicator is changed from 0 to 1 
  filter(Donor != "random seeds")

HR_23 <- HR_23 %>%
  # Create a grouping variable for every 5 rows
  mutate(group = sample_ID_SEG) %>%
  # Calculate the sum of 'surv_to_flower' within each group
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(total_surv_to_flower = sum(surv_to_flower, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% # Ungroup to avoid grouped data frame
  # Remove the temporary 'group' column using dplyr::select
  dplyr::select(-group)

 HR_23 <- HR_23 %>%#if you survived to flower, but a fitness plant wasn't picked, then pick one
   group_by(sample_ID_SEG) %>%
   arrange(Transect, Recipient, Donor, sample_ID_SEG, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
   mutate(
     has_f = any(F_plant == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
     surv_l = coalesce(surv_to_flower == 1, FALSE),  # TRUE if survived
     F_plant = case_when(
       has_f ~ F_plant,                                        # keep existing
       !has_f & any(surv_l) & row_number() == which(surv_l)[1] ~ 1L,  # first survivor
       TRUE ~ F_plant
     )
   )

#Ensure at least one F_plant per sample_ID prefix (first 19 characters)
HR_23 <- HR_23 %>%
  group_by(sample_ID_SEG) %>%
  arrange(Transect, Recipient, Donor, sample_ID_SEG, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    has_f = any(F_plant == 1),
    m_surv = sum(surv_to_flower == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    # if none marked, pick deterministically:
    F_plant = case_when(
      has_f ~ F_plant,# keep existing
      !has_f & m_surv == 0 & row_number() == 1L ~ 1L,    # no survivors: pick first row (placeholder)
      TRUE ~ F_plant
    )
  )

#Filter to just fitness plants
HR_23_G1 <- HR_23 %>%
  filter(F_plant == 1) %>%
  filter(Gen == "G1") %>%
  ungroup(sample_ID_SEG)

HR_23_G1 %>%
```
